intro.zh: 800 行规则，为什么反而让 AI 更不听话？从一线开发的返工，到 Anthropic 对子 Agent 的反思，这周我们把注意力放回任务本身。
intro.en: Why did 800 lines of rules make an agent less reliable? A developer’s rebuild and Anthropic’s advice on subagents bring the focus back to the work.

guide.zh: 把规则放对地方，把交接减到必要；再问一个更大的问题：当机器做得越来越快，人该把时间留给什么？
guide.en: Put rules where they work and keep handoffs that earn their cost. Then ask: as machines get faster, what deserves our time?

detail.zh: 800 行规则、子 Agent 与真正该留下的约束。
detail.en: Rules, subagents and the constraints worth keeping.

headline.zh: 越想让它听话，为什么越难交付？

standfirst.zh: 一位游戏开发者的失败，让「多写几条规则」这条捷径失效了。接下来要做的，是重新安排信息、判断与检查各自的位置。
standfirst.en: A game developer’s failed rulebook exposes the limits of adding instructions. The next step is to rethink where information, judgment and checks belong.

detail.zh: Jev 的点赞争议，与 98% 物理题成绩的边界。
detail.en: Jev’s suspicious likes and the scope of a physics result.

standfirst.zh: 两个醒目的百分比，一边讨论声量的可信度，一边讨论模型的解题能力。它们需要完全不同的判断。
standfirst.en: One percentage concerns the credibility of popularity; the other measures problem solving. They need different kinds of scrutiny.

detail.zh: 设计、网页、记忆、声音，以及十个具体的 Bot。
detail.en: Design, web pages, memory, sound and ten focused bots.

headline.zh: 功能不必多，先把一件事做好
headline.en: Give one job a better tool

standfirst.zh: 产品用短读呈现；配图来自官网、项目仓库或原帖。
standfirst.en: Short product notes, with images from official sites, repositories or the saved post.

detail.zh: 岗位入口、公益股权与个人 Agent 的商业问题。
detail.en: Entry-level work, public-benefit equity and personal agents.

headline.zh: 效率增加之后，机会交给谁？
headline.en: After productivity rises, who gets a chance?

standfirst.zh: 如果只统计省了多少时间，就会漏掉另两笔账：新人怎样学会工作，谁能分享技术带来的收益。
standfirst.en: Time saved is only one account. Two others matter: how newcomers learn, and who shares the value technology creates.

detail.zh: 改一台 Kindle、做一个产品，以及重新找回好奇心。
detail.en: A Kindle project, product judgment and curiosity.

headline.zh: 当终点变近了，还想走哪一段路？
headline.en: With the finish line closer, what is worth doing?

standfirst.zh: 一个人用 AI 找回折腾设备的乐趣，另一个人却因为一切太容易而失落。这两种感受，可以同时成立。
standfirst.en: One writer finds joy in tinkering with AI; another feels adrift when creation becomes effortless. Both experiences can be real.
